args.title: docs(venice-audit-v1): stage > substage > granular hierarchy audit v2 with per-substage visual Gantts
args.body:
Revision PR for assignment repo-hierarchical-audit-v2 (supersedes repo-requirements-audit-v1 / PR #226). Reuses the published v1 findings and adds the newly requested hierarchy.

Scope on venice/repo-hierarchical-audit-v2 (all under allowed_paths):
- STAGES.csv, SUBSTAGES.csv, REQUIREMENTS.csv with the eight separate lifecycle status dimensions and percentages scoped to individual substages only.
- QUESTION_INDEX.csv of actual yes/no questions bound to real substages (S4.1 design, S5.1 answer+verification, S5B.1 alias).
- charts/CHART_INDEX.csv plus 20 per-substage SVG Gantts (S0.1..S8.1) covering every required item and its status.
- Nested reporting: README.md entrypoint, GANTT.md overview, details/<substage-id>.md granular pages, EVIDENCE.json ledger.
- agent/repo_requirements_audit_validate.py and tests/test_repo_requirements_audit.py asserting parity, STATUS_VALUES, chart and details coverage.
- .github/workflows/venice-repo-requirements-audit.yml regenerating and committing the artifacts, exact branch filter and narrow paths.

Verification: push-triggered run 42769891308 success at 9840e39e (validator mapping + generator revert) and run 42775425837 success at 69a27869 (PROGRESS.json re-keyed to this assignment). Audit completion does not open the world/scoring/live gates.
